title: A long Pays for list scrolls inside the window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser at least 1440 pixels wide.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have twenty new customers for this test whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B, so the list is longer than the window.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's page.
  2. Click the "Pays for" counter.
  3. Scroll the list inside the window to its end.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Pays for" counter shows 20.

Step 2:

  • The window shows the first names of the list, A to Z, and a scroll bar inside the window.
  • The "Close" button stays visible.

Step 3:

  • The list scrolls inside the window while the window's title and its "Close" button stay in place.
  • The twentieth name, the last in A to Z order, shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R9: “Clicking the counter opens a window titled "[customer] pays for", listing each customer A to Z as a link to its page; a long list scrolls inside the window.”
